visual.general_description: Two unlettered laparoscopic operative views with visible blue-purple suture material.
visual.detailed_description: Two unlettered color intra-abdominal operative views sit side by side on white. In the left view, shiny brown/pink tissue and yellow fatty tissue surround several long blue-purple suture strands extending downward from the upper edge toward small puncture/red spots in the lower central tissue. A curved strand traverses the left field. In the right view, brown smooth tissue fills the frame with a central raised fold, small dark/blue suture material and punctate red sites, with yellow fatty tissue along the lower edge. Wet surfaces reflect small white highlights. No panel letters, scale, arrows or quantitative anatomical measurement are shown; suture caliber and anatomy come from the article/caption.

visual.general_description: FSSG questionnaire and twelve paired clinical response plots with Cases1–4 legend.
visual.detailed_description: A black-bordered FSSG questionnaire table occupies the left third, with twelve numbered questions. Twelve miniature pre/post line plots Q1–Q12 occupy a three-row, four-column grid on the right. Every chart has horizontal gray grid lines at response scores0–4 and x labels pre/post. The top-right legend labels Case1 solid black, Case2 dotted black, Case3 solid red and Case4 dotted red. Most lines descend toward0; Q11 has a horizontal dotted black series at2 and a solid black4-to2 series, and Q10 has a horizontal solid black series at1. Several traces lie on or slightly offset from the zero baseline and overlap other traces. Asterisks appear on Q1,Q2,Q3,Q4,Q6; a bottom-right key reads * P<0.05. Under the questionnaire, the printed response key is0:never,1:occasionally,2:sometimes,3:often,4:always. There is no acquisition modality, anatomical photograph, absolute date or printed individual total score.

mentioned_categories.visual_cue: Upper-right legend: Case1 solid black, Case2 dotted black, Case3 solid red, Case4 dotted red
Printed key beneath left questionnaire table

pixel_observations: A black-bordered FSSG questionnaire table occupies the left third, with twelve numbered questions. Twelve miniature pre/post line plots Q1–Q12 occupy a three-row, four-column grid on the right. Every chart has horizontal gray grid lines at response scores0–4 and x labels pre/post. The top-right legend labels Case1 solid black, Case2 dotted black, Case3 solid red and Case4 dotted red. Most lines descend toward0; Q11 has a horizontal dotted black series at2 and a solid black4-to2 series, and Q10 has a horizontal solid black series at1. Several traces lie on or slightly offset from the zero baseline and overlap other traces. Asterisks appear on Q1,Q2,Q3,Q4,Q6; a bottom-right key reads * P<0.05. Under the questionnaire, the printed response key is0:never,1:occasionally,2:sometimes,3:often,4:always. There is no acquisition modality, anatomical photograph, absolute date or printed individual total score.

evidence.quote: Frequency scale for the symptoms of GERD (FSSG) before and after hiatal repair and gastropexy without fundoplication.

clinical_significance.statement: The authors compare FSSG symptom responses before and after the no-fundoplication operations, reporting significant score differences in questions1,2,3,4,6. These are questionnaire responses, not endoscopically established GERD or a new diagnosis. Individual trace estimates remain separate from the article’s pooled total-score claims.

evidence.quote: Changes in the FSSG scores before and after surgery are shown in Fig. 2.
In questions 1, 2, 3, 4, and 6, there were significant differences when comparing the scores before and after surgery.

limitations: All96 endpoints are approximate plot readings with uncertainty from overlapping or coincident traces; not printed exact point values. No total questionnaire score derived or numeric clinical facts inserted from this visual sidecar. No invented panel letters: Q1–Q12 are chart titles inside one whole-figure scope.
